notes.text: Code-led build. context.mjs reported no image generation on this machine (IMAGE_TOOLS lists only the ffmpeg converter), so per new-work.md code-led is the only path and the comp round is skipped by contract. The target is Unity C# IMGUI + UI Toolkit, not a browser surface: comp-spec, plates, comp-diff and viewport captures have no referent here, and no Unity editor or .NET SDK is installed to build or screenshot the app. Ambition rides in the direction contract's FIRST VIEWPORT block and named signature interaction.

reasons: 0 comps under .impeccable\mocks; the comp round puts three compositional options of the chosen direction in front of the user (reference/visualize.md). Generate the missing ones (harness image tool or generate-image.mjs), each with a .json sidecar holding its prompt.

no comp is approved: put the three comps in front of the user (decision page via serve-question.mjs, or the structured question tool), then set "approved": true in the chosen comp's sidecar. A delegated pick is recorded the same way and disclosed.
